name: Rowanmettle
description: Hold the stave high and level while qi spreads through the arms as a watchful field, ready to answer any line of attack.

name: Staffflash
description: Glide forward in a matched pair of steps, qi carrying the body smoothly while the stave keeps its guard.

name: Ashruin
description: Rap down from the high guard onto the opponent's weapon hand, qi flashing along the shaft to the tip.

name: Chime Ashwood
description: Draw a straight azure line with the stave to meet a blow and push it aside, qi firming the arms.

name: Glint Rapidspin
description: Thrust the stave along a flowing line that cuts through the guard like a river through a bank, qi narrowing at the tip.

name: Webbing Nodeknot
description: Cross the stave and its qi field over the opponent's weapon and pin it down, one track holding and one free.

name: Confluent Staffspin
description: Strike in two tracks at once, the stave to the head and the qi field to the knee, linking the blows.

name: Decimating Quarterpoint
description: Dive the stave from the high guard in a heavy smash, qi gathering at the tip and breaking on impact.

name: Titanic Sanguine Staffend
description: Hold the dive a heartbeat while qi gathers, then loose two descending strikes along a pair of lines at once.

name: Staffdurance
description: Settle into a wide basin stance with the stave across the knees, qi pooling low and still in the legs.

name: Blinding Poleturn
description: Flow forward on a steady, gliding step as a river runs, qi moving evenly through the legs and the stave.

name: Staffscourge
description: Sweep the stave in a low arc like water spilling from a basin, qi hardening the shaft.

name: Ashnerve
description: Beat the opponent's weapon with a short firm tap of the stave, qi pulsing to shake the grip.

name: Murk Staffend
description: Turn a blow in a swirling eddy of the stave and throw it wide, qi stiffening the shaft at the turn.

name: Iron Staffspin
description: Thrust the stave along a flowing line to the opponent's body past the guard, qi sharpening the tip.

name: Rowanruin
description: Link a strike and a counter-strike in the rhythm of two currents meeting, qi surging at the joining point.

name: Reverberating Rapidspin
description: Strike in a mounting series of blows that rise like a river in flood, each carrying more qi than the last.

name: Mangling Rollover
description: Gather qi in the stave like water in a basin, then pour it out in one crushing downward smash.

name: Merciless Staffsweep
description: Hold qi at full gather until the stave trembles, then release it along two courses in a single double strike.

name: Oakvalor
description: Stand with the stave in the return-ready guard, qi held gently in the forearms for a counter at once.

name: Ashglimmer
description: Step back in a pair of quick glides, the stave tracing a line the opponent cannot easily enter.

name: Oakwrath
description: Strike along a held line, the stave tip drawing the opponent's weapon into its path, qi flaring on contact.

name: Gust Nodeknot
description: Parry on the line and return along it, the same motion serving both defence and counter, qi easing the arms.

name: Charter Poleturn
description: Tap the opponent's weapon and rebound the stave along the line to strike again before they recover.

name: Staffgrip Nerve
description: Hook the opponent's guard with the stave end and return the stave along the line, pulling the weapon aside.

name: Escalating Rollover
description: Chain strikes and returns along one line, each return arming the next strike, qi carried along the shaft.

name: Eviscerating Staffend
description: Beat the opponent's guard twice along the line in a rapid pair, qi doubling at the second stroke.

name: Nova Jabbing
description: Draw the stave back along the line while gathering qi, then thrust at the centre of the opponent's body in a single piercing motion.

name: Ashspine
description: Hold the stave across the body with qi in each hand, each end of the shaft guarded as a separate weapon.

name: Silt Rollover
description: Step in a feinting glide, the left end of the stave threatening one line as the body moves to another.

name: Wrathful Staffspin
description: Rap with the left end of the stave in a quick pulse, qi flaring at the tip.

name: Rowanhavoc
description: Rap with the right end of the stave in a quick pulse, answering the left from the other side.

name: Torrent Midstaff
description: Cross the two ends of the stave in a parry that catches and turns a heavy blow, qi hardening the shaft.

name: Perchmettle
description: Strike the opponent's weapon with both ends of the stave in quick order, qi shaking the grip loose.

name: Multiplying Staffsweep
description: Alternate strikes from the two ends in a rapid chain, each one stronger than the last, qi crackling along the shaft.

name: Fastening Ironcap
description: Hook the opponent's weapon between the two ends of the stave and hold it fast, qi locking the grip.

name: Piercing Quarterpoint
description: Drop both ends of the stave in the same instant, one high and one low, qi tracing a pair of lines to the target.

name: Grievous Poleturn
description: Gather qi along the whole stave and let it fall as one heavy stroke that breaks the opponent's guard.

name: Perchnerve
description: Settle in a guard with both tracks ready, qi in a smooth field around the arms and the stave.

name: Perchblink
description: Shift from one track to the other with a gliding step, qi flowing from legs to arms to keep the stave on line.

name: Rapidspin Reckoning
description: Strike along the first track to draw a guard, qi quick in the shoulders.

name: Booming Jabbing
description: Strike along the second track the instant the guard moves, qi following the first blow.

name: Equipoise Staffend
description: Cross from one track to the other during a parry, redirecting the blow and setting up a counter.

name: Mayhem Nodeknot
description: Press the opponent's weapon down into the basin of the guard and hold it, qi steady along the stave.

name: Oakhavoc
description: Run through strikes and guards on both tracks in a single unbroken flow, qi never pausing.

name: Rumble Staffshoe
description: Merge both tracks into a single piercing thrust at the instant of contact, qi doubling at the tip.

name: Strangling Ironcap
description: Wrap the stave and the qi field around the opponent's weapon from both tracks and hold it still.

name: Confluent Rollover
description: Reverse the whole sequence mid-flow, striking back along each track in turn, qi tracing the path.

name: Unconquered Oakstaff
description: Return to the guard in silence after a long exchange, qi sinking back into the legs and the stave.

name: Shattering Rumble Rollover
description: Build qi on both tracks together and release them at the same instant in a single overwhelming blow.

name: Staffmettle
description: Crouch beneath the stave held diagonally, qi coiled in the legs like a hawk poised to rise.

name: Silt Staffend
description: Rise on a springing step as if on an updraft, qi lifting the body while the stave swings high.

name: Oakscourge
description: Rise from the crouch and rap upward at the opponent's chin, qi flashing along the shaft.

name: Equipoise Ironcap
description: Sweep the stave wide to one side like a wing, deflecting a blow and opening the opponent's guard.

name: Facet Poleturn
description: Thrust the near end into the opponent's centre in a sharp narrow stab, qi gathering to a point.

name: Rowanspine
description: Catch the opponent's weapon between the stave and a stooped arm and hold it, qi locking the grip.

name: Reverberating Staffspin
description: Strike at rising heights in turn, each higher than the last, qi flaring at each landing.

name: Lacerating Staffsweep
description: Spring into the air and spin the stave in a heavy circle that lands from above, qi at full flare.

name: Dazzling Balancegrip
description: Vault back to a guarded distance in one bound of qi, the stave held ready on landing.

name: Ferocious Jabbing
description: Rise to full height, gather qi, and fall into a diving smash that breaks the opponent's guard and weapon.

name: Rowandurance
description: Spread the arms wide along the stave in a guard that covers both sides, qi spreading through the shoulders.

name: Oakvortex
description: Step to the side in a long gliding step as a hawk banks, qi carrying the stave across the front.

name: Staffwrath
description: Strike down on the left in a sweeping stroke, qi trailing from the spread arm.

name: Sanguine Poleturn
description: Strike down on the right in a sweeping stroke, qi trailing from the other arm.

name: Murk Oakstaff
description: Beat the stave like a wing against an incoming blow and shed it off to the side, qi firming the shaft.

name: Toxin Staffgrip
description: Draw both arms together to press the stave against the opponent's weapon from both sides, qi tightening the grip.

name: Staffsweep Wrath
description: Alternate left and right wing strikes in a wide flowing rhythm, qi building with each beat.

name: Tempered Rollover
description: Thrust the stave in a narrow line like a hawk's flight feather, qi sharp and thin at the tip.

name: Rampaging Staffspin
description: Fold the arms and drive the stave down in a stoop like a hawk with folded wings, qi accumulating on the way down.

name: Mastering Balancegrip
description: Close both arms about the opponent's weapon like folding wings and hold it, qi in a steady field.

name: Hellish Staffend
description: Spread the wings wide and gather qi from the whole field, then close them in a heavy smash from both sides at once.

name: Ashvalor
description: Settle into a deep stance with the stave across the body, qi from the full meridian network pooling in the legs.

name: Granite Quarterpoint
description: Move in a steady glide, qi flowing through the whole meridian network to carry the body.

name: Rowanscourge
description: Strike with qi drawn from the full meridian network in a single clean line.

name: Impervious Nodeknot
description: Parry with the stave and let the pooled qi surge into the arms, turning the blow aside.

name: Nova Rapidspin
description: Thrust the stave in a long flowing line, qi running through the arms to a narrow point.

name: Overpowering Ashwood
description: Press the stave down on the opponent's weapon and hold it, qi from the network keeping the grip locked.

name: Multiplying Poleturn
description: Channel qi through two meridian paths at once and strike twice along linked lines.

name: Unassailable Staffgrip
description: Hold the stave in a long guard while qi from the network settles evenly through the stance.

name: Gnashing Quarterpoint
description: Gather qi from the whole network and break it on a single downward smash.

name: Hoarfrost Midstaff
description: Take the bearing and set the stave on it, qi spreading through the arms as a field that feels the wind.

name: Rowanglare
description: Step into the wind with the stave level, qi lightening the body and holding the bearing.

name: Rollover Scourge
description: Rap along the bearing at the opponent's weapon hand, qi flashing down the shaft.

name: Oakdurance
description: Beat the opponent's weapon off its line with a sideways rap of the stave, qi shaking the grip.

name: Relentless Rapidspin
description: Thrust along the bearing like an oath that cannot be turned, qi narrowing to a point at the tip.

name: Unrelenting Ashwood
description: Shed an incoming blow along the stave as the wind sheds a leaf, qi firming the arms.

name: Escalating Staffspin
description: Keep the bearing fixed through a chain of strikes, each blow carried along the line, qi pulsing at the tip.

name: Enthralling Ironcap
description: Close the stave over the opponent's weapon and hold it, qi making the hold as firm as a sworn word.

name: Wrathful Tempered Quarterpoint
description: Hold the stave over the bearing while qi gathers, then split the opponent's guard in one downward blow.

name: Aegisash
description: Hold a stout guard with the stave across the chest, qi gathered in the legs like roots in the plateau.

name: Torrent Staffend
description: Advance in an even steady step into the wind, qi keeping the body level.

name: Mightash
description: Thrust the stave at the chest in a single committed push, qi driving the tip.

name: Torrent Staffgrip
description: Parry across the body and turn the blow downwind, qi firming the shaft at the turn.

name: Devastating Rapidspin
description: Sweep the stave along a level line that clears the way ahead, qi hardening the wood.

name: Immobilizing Nodeknot
description: Hold the opponent's weapon pinned under the stave without wavering, qi locking the grip.

name: Perchscourge
description: Advance with a chain of strikes that does not pause or retreat, each blow carrying qi.

name: Ponderous Jabbing
description: Rap in a quick gusting series at head, hand and knee, qi driving each beat.

name: Punishing Midstaff
description: Smash down once the opponent's guard is open, qi gathered along the whole shaft.

name: Adamantine Balancegrip
description: Stand firm in the guard after the exchange, qi sinking into the legs and the stave held as a wall of wood.

name: Brutalizing Staffsweep
description: Draw qi into the stave until it hums, then drive it forward in a gale-force blow that shatters a guard.

name: Thornoak
description: Stand with the stave planted ahead as a brace at a drop's edge, qi settling deep into the legs.

name: Silt Rapidspin
description: Walk along the rim with short sliding steps, qi keeping the weight low while the stave holds the guard.

name: Perchwrath
description: Rap the stave sideways at an opponent's legs to push them toward the drop, qi flashing along the wood.

name: Midstaff Tenacity
description: Turn a blow aside to the open side with a sweep of the stave, qi holding the arms firm.

name: Iron Jabbing
description: Thrust along the held bearing so the opponent must step back toward the edge, qi narrow at the tip.

name: Hogtying Staffshoe
description: Press the stave against the opponent's body and push them back toward the edge, qi pulsing through the arms.

name: Escalating Staffsweep
description: Drive the opponent along the edge with chain strikes, each pushing them further along the line, qi quickening each.

name: Ruinous Staffsweep
description: Sweep the stave under the opponent and lift, qi surging through the legs to unbalance them.

name: Harnessing Staffgrip
description: Pin the opponent's weapon against the stave at the edge so a step back would cost them their footing, qi locking the hold.

name: Rampaging Rollover
description: Gather qi at the planted stave and then drive forward with a heavy blow that breaks an opponent's footing and guard.

name: Aegis Quarterpoint
description: Take the first stance of the forms facing the wind, the stave held across the body, qi settling.

name: Staffglimmer
description: Change facing with a quick pivot step to a new bearing, qi turning the legs and the stave together.

name: Perchhavoc
description: Strike from the right in a long sweeping stroke like a wind from the east, qi hardening the shaft.

name: Blaze Rapidspin
description: Strike from the left in a long sweeping stroke like a wind from the west, qi following the swing.

name: Unconquered Nodeknot
description: Parry a blow with a turning movement of the stave, qi in the wrists keeping the shaft supple.

name: Numbing Staffshoe
description: Strike across the opponent's line so the next blow lands where they cannot guard, qi quickening the timing.

name: Overlapping Jabbing
description: Strike in four directions in succession, each from a different bearing, qi linking the blows.

name: Facet Rollover
description: Thrust straight ahead along the bearing like a cold north wind, qi narrowing to a point.

name: Gyveoak
description: Stop all movement and bind the opponent's weapon at the still centre of the forms, qi locking the hold.

name: Vengeful Staffsweep
description: Smash down from a high guard with a warm surging blow, qi flaring at impact.

name: Reverberating Quarterpoint
description: End the forms with a wheel of the stave through all four bearings, qi circling through the whole body.

name: Booming Staffsweep
description: Gather qi from the four winds of the forms into the stave and release it in a single heavy blow.

name: Granite Ironcap
description: Hold a guard that depends on nothing at the back, qi spreading evenly around the body in a ring.

name: Dazzling Rollover
description: Glide across bare ground in a long low step, qi carrying the stave steadily.

name: Rumbleoak
description: Strike along the horizon line at head height with a flat sweeping blow, qi hardening the shaft.

name: Equipoise Staffgrip
description: Meet a blow in the open and turn it aside with the shaft held loosely, qi stiffening at contact.

name: Tempered Staffend
description: Thrust along a bearing that the opponent cannot read from the side, qi narrowing at the tip.

name: Poleturn Mettle
description: Press the opponent back with a stroke timed to the wind's push, qi surging through the arms.

name: Ashwrath
description: Circle the opponent with strikes from every side, each from a new bearing, qi pulsing at each landing.

name: Thorn Ashwood
description: Close in with the stave over the opponent's weapon and hold it with nothing to lean on, qi steadying the stance.

name: Gnashing Staffend
description: Sweep the stave in a wide gale along the ground, qi extending the reach past the wood.

name: Indomitable Midstaff
description: Parry wide to the plateau side and return along the same sweep, qi in the wrists.

name: Synchronized Staffend
description: Chain open-ground strikes freely in whatever order the wind of the exchange allows, qi sustaining the flow.

name: Grievous Staffsweep
description: Rise to the crest of the exchange and strike downward through the opponent's guard, qi building on the way up.

name: Devastating Might Poleturn
description: Gather qi along the whole stave and fire it forward in one mighty blow that flattens a guard in its path.

name: Facet Ironcap
description: Crouch low with the stave trailing, qi coiled in the legs, as a gale keeps close to the ground.

name: Headlong Oakstaff
description: Skim over the ground in a quick sliding step, qi carrying the weight on the toes.

name: Staffhavoc
description: Rap in passing at the opponent's knee as the body glides by, qi flashing in the tip.

name: Chime Quarterpoint
description: Parry a blow in motion and keep moving, the stave turning the force off to the side, qi firming the arms.

name: Rumble Jabbing
description: Slide through the opponent's guard on a long low step and thrust, qi narrowing the tip.

name: Toxinash
description: Tangle the stave among the opponent's feet as the body glides past, qi steadying the arms.

name: Multiplying Staffspin
description: Pursue the opponent across the ground in a chain of gliding strikes, qi sustaining the pace.

name: Might Staffgrip
description: Cut back across the opponent's line on a quick qi-lightened step and strike from behind.

name: Poleturn Devastation
description: Rise from the crouch with a heavy upward smash, qi surging from the legs.

name: Synchronized Staffsweep
description: Spin through the opponent's guard with the stave extended, qi whirling through the shaft as the body turns.

name: Pitiless Staffspin
description: Gather qi in the legs and release it on a single stamping step that drives the stave's blow through the guard.

name: Ironash
description: Open in a guard that is also a pledge to hold, qi flowing evenly in the arms.

name: Granite Balancegrip
description: Advance and retreat in a pledge-bound rhythm, qi keeping the weight balanced on the plateau.

name: Blazeash
description: Rap the opponent's lead hand as a challenge, qi flicking down the shaft.

name: Gust Ironcap
description: Parry a challenge and answer it at once with a blow, qi firming the arms in the turn.

name: Nova Staffend
description: Thrust along the sworn bearing, qi keeping the blow true to its line.

name: Hogtying Staffgrip
description: Hold the opponent's weapon in place and keep it there as a vow is kept, qi locking the grip.

name: Confluent Rapidspin
description: Meet a series of attacks with a chain of paired parries and strikes, qi steadying each pair.

name: Brutalizing Rollover
description: Smash down along the bearing with the full weight of the body, qi gathered along the shaft.

name: Obdurate Ashwood
description: Return to the sworn guard after each exchange and wait, qi settling into the legs.

name: Decimating Rollover
description: Hold the stave in guard while qi gathers, then loose it as a blow that answers all the exchanges before it.

name: Charter Oakstaff
description: Root the stance like a plateau stone, qi from the full meridian network settling in the legs.

name: Oakflash
description: Move in a steady glide, qi flowing through the entire meridian network and carrying the stave along.

name: Ashhavoc
description: Strike with qi from the whole network in one committed blow along the bearing.

name: Murk Nodeknot
description: Parry with the stave and let the networked qi surge into the arms, turning the blow aside.

name: Driving Staffspin
description: Thrust along the bearing with qi drawn from the network, narrowing at the tip.

name: Enthralling Staffend
description: Press the stave on the opponent's weapon and hold it, qi from the network keeping the grip firm.

name: Rapidspin Havoc
description: Chain strikes along the bearing while qi flows through the meridians in matching order.

name: Inexorable Balancegrip
description: Stand in guard while qi from the network sinks into the stance.

name: Eviscerating Poleturn
description: Gather qi from the whole network and drop it into one downward smash.
